desc:
🍬 MERGE SQUISHY BALLS 🍬
Drop squishy jelly balls into the cup and merge matching ones to grow bigger, cuter balls! How far can you go?

🎯 HOW TO PLAY
• Aim and tap to drop a ball
• Two matching balls touch → they MERGE into the next one!
• Chain merges for huge COMBOS and big scores
• Don't let any ball spill out of the cup!

✨ FEATURES
• 9 squishy balls to discover – from tiny Pip to giant Nova
• Reach the end to face the secret Developer boss 😈
• Powers: Pop, Shake, Freeze & Tall Cup
• Collect tons of skins from Ball Capsules
• Spin the Lucky Wheel for prizes
• Upgrade tree, daily rewards, goals & free playtime gifts
• Climb the Top 50 leaderboards 🏆

🎮📱🖥️ Supports Desktop, Mobile, and Console players.

👍 Like & ⭐ Favorite to get new updates!
